Priya S: Heads up team — new hire Jordan P (PM) starts Monday. Drafted a compressed first-week agenda + 30/60/90. Posting here for IT/eng/HR to action access & equipment.

Priya S: ```
Day 1: HR intro, benefits, laptop handoff, security briefing
Day 2: Dev environment + GitHub org access, repo walkthrough, meet eng lead
Day 3: Product context, roadmap overview, stakeholder intros
Day 4: Shadowing & small starter ticket, staging access
Day 5: 30-min goals check-in, set 30/60/90 milestones
30/60/90 highlights: 30d = learn codebase & infra; 60d = own small feature; 90d = deliver cross-team project
Needed accounts: Okta, Slack, GitHub (org: redwood-inc), JIRA (product-pm), VPN, GCP read
```

Priya S: Jordan details: jordan.parrish@example.com, prefers macOS. Can we prioritize Okta + GitHub so they can clone by Day 2?

IT Support: I'll check Okta invites. If pending, we can re-send and escalate auto-provision. Re-sent Okta invite at 1718204575.

Devex Bot: GH quick action (if using gh CLI): ```gh api orgs/redwood-inc/teams/product-pm/memberships --raw-field role=member -F username=jordan.parrish``` If no CLI, eng can send manual invite.

Nora L: I can handle the GitHub invite. Will add Jordan to product-pm and grant repo read. Sending invite now.

Elaine H: Payroll/forms note: Jordan still needs to complete the onboarding packet. I re-sent the forms — please complete ASAP to avoid payroll delay. Equipment ship scheduled for tomorrow.

Jordan P: Thanks folks! Accepted Okta invite and filled forms. Quick Q: who to ping if the VPN profile doesn't show after Okta acceptance?

IT Support: Ping this channel or open a ticket at https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk - we'll prioritize onboarding tickets.

Priya S: Thanks all. Can we do a 30-min sync Friday to finalize week 1 tasks? I'll send a calendar invite. :thumbsup:
